record.rsp_body:
@echo off
setlocal ENABLEDELAYEDEXPANSION
:: param1---node.zip
set node_file_pre=%1
:: ---------------------------prepare node path--------------------------------------
set node_parent=D:
op\necho node_parent=%node_parent%
set node_path=%node_parent%%node_file_pre%\necho "node_path:"%node_path%
set path=%node_path%;C:\Program Files\WinRAR;%path%
echo "path:"%path%
set origin_folder=%~dp0
echo %origin_folder%
cd ..
set parent_folder=%cd%
echo parent_folder%parent_folder%
set tool_folder=%parent_folder%\dev_tools
echo tool_folder%tool_folder%
if not exist %node_path% (
	echo remove dir %node_path%
	rd /s /q %node_path%
	call WinRAR.exe X %tool_folder%\%node_file_pre%.zip %node_parent%
)

cd %origin_folder%

::---------------------------check ng-----------------------------------
:ng
call where ng
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:ngOK
		echo "-----ng is already installed-----"
		call ng version
	) else (
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

	::---------------------------install ng-----------------------------------
		echo "-----install @angular/cli@8.1.0... -----"
		call npm install @angular/cli@8.1.0
		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call ng version
		) else (
			@echo "-----global install ng cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)
::--- add --max_old_space_size=4096 to ng.cmd
call xcopy %tool_folder%
g.cmd %node_path% /H /K /R /Y

::---------------------------check waf-----------------------------------
:waf
call where waf
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:wafOK
		echo "-----waf is already installed-----"
		call waf --version
	) else (
	::---------------------------install waf-----------------------------------
		:: set node-sass binary path just for this bat
		echo parent_folder=%parent_folder%
		set SASS_BINARY_PATH=%tool_folder%\win32-x64-64_binding.node
		echo "SASS_BINARY_PATH:" !SASS_BINARY_PATH!
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

		echo "-----install waf... -----"
		call npm install @waf_cli/cli

		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call waf --version
		) else (
			echo "-----install waf cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)

:: ---------------------------check npm 3.10.10--------------------------------------
for /F %%i in ('npm -v')do set npm_version=%%i
echo npm_version=!npm_version!
if !npm_version!==3.10.10 (
	call npm -v
) else (
    echo "-----npm version is not avalable!-----"
	echo "-----replace npm@!npm_version! with npm@3.10.10 -----"
	if exist %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip del %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip
	xcopy %tool_folder%
pm@3.10.10.zip	 %node_path%
ode_modules\n	rd %node_path%
ode_modules
pm /S /Q
	call WinRAR.exe X %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip %node_path%
ode_modules
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		echo "-----npm@3.10.10 is already installed! current version:-----"
		call npm -v
	) else (
		echo "-----install npm@3.10.10 failed! -----"
		goto end
	)
)

cd %origin_folder%
call build-2.bat %node_file_pre%
:end
echo "-----end pre-build.bat-----"

#!/bin/bash
source /etc/profile
cd /etc/init.d

chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# chmod 777 /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

if [ -d "/usr/local/nginx" ];then
rm -r /user/local/nginx
fi

chkconfig --del unmstart.server

chkconfig --del unmtoolstart.server

chkconfig --del passtart.server

#Í£Ö¹·þÎñ

/etc/init.d/unmstop.server
/etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server stop
/etc/init.d/unmtao.server stop


$UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

#È¡Ïû¿ª»ú×ÔÆô¶¯
chkconfig -d unmactivemq.server
chkconfig -d unmtao.server
result=$(cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
    systemctl disable unm2000.service
    systemctl disable unmtool.service 
    # systemctl disable tomcat.service
else
    chkconfig -del unmstart.server
    chkconfig -del unmtoolstart.server
    # chkconfig -del tomcat.service
fi

#cusaÐ¶ÔØ±ß³µ
revisionfile=$UNM_ROOT/server/etc/revision.txt
grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul
if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/sidecar/bin/uninstall_sidecar_service.sh
fi

# Ð¶ÔØ¹ÜÀí¹¤¾ß
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/scripts/uninstall_nmtool.sh

#Ð¶ÔØnginx
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nginx/script_linux/uninstall_service.sh

if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
#Ð¶ÔØjetty
sh $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
fi

cd $UNM_ROOT/script
# rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unm.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtool.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtoolstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmactivemq.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtao.server

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' \n'python-cipherclient' \n'python-licenseclient' \n'python-monitorclient' \n'python-serviceclient' \n'update' \n'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' \n'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7:60022/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.150.2.132
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.150.2.132:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
scp -P60022 ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
ssh fh@10.150.2.132 "scp -P60022 /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
ssh -p60022 root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' 'python-cipherclient' 'python-licenseclient' 'python-monitorclient' 'python-serviceclient' 'update' 'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' 'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' 'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' 'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m2


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
temp_dir=$1

SOURCE_DIR=unm_cm_service
TARGET_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/../$SOURCE_DIR/unm_cm_service_java/unm-cm-distribution/target
#解压之后的位置
THIRDPARTY_PATH=$TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/thirdparty
NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH=$THIRDPARTY_PATH/nginx/html/nmtool
TEMP_DIR_PATH=$SCRIPT_DIR/$temp_dir
WEB_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/../dist/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0


#解压压缩包
unzip -q -o $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip -d $TARGET_PATH
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#制作windows压缩包 unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip

#javaservice
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/javaservice.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#jdk1.8.0_171
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/jdk1.8.0_171.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#nginx
unzip -q -o $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.zip -d $THIRDPARTY_PATH
#前端代码
if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi


cd  $TARGET_PATH
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#制作linux压缩包
rm -rf $THIRDPARTY_PATH/*

#java
cp $TEMP_DIR_PATH/openjdk-8u41.tar.gz $THIRDPARTY_PATH

#nginx
tar -xf $TEMP_DIR_PATH/nginx.tar -C $THIRDPARTY_PATH

if [ ! -f $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip ];
then
	echo not exit nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
else
    echo unzip nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip
	unzip -q -o $WEB_DIR/nmtool_nmtool_1.0.0_run*.zip -d $NGINX_NMTOOL_PATH
fi
zip -r -q $TARGET_PATH/unm-nmtool-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-linux.zip unm_cm_agent/ unm_cm_service/

#删除相关文件
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_agent/
rm -rf $TARGET_PATH/unm_cm_service/

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' \n'python-cipherclient' \n'python-licenseclient' \n'python-monitorclient' \n'python-serviceclient' \n'update' \n'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' \n'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"
